review_candidates.title: Audio Visual Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Qualifications Strong experience with Digital Signage solutions and related display technologies. Proficient Troubleshooting skills for AV, network-connected devices, and related infrastructure.
eligibility_evidence: Company Description AMCO Technology International (ATI), founded in 2011 as a subsidiary of AMCO Holding Company, has grown into a leading trading and engineering company in Egypt.
Role Description The Audio Visual Engineer is a full-time, hybrid role based in Cairo, with flexibility for some work from home.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work on-site and remotely in a hybrid setup.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Qualifications Strong experience with Digital Signage solutions and related display technologies. Hands-on expertise in Audio Visual (AV) Systems and AV Integration for corporate or commercial environments. Proficient Troubleshooting skills for AV, network-connected devices, and related infrastructure.
